theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the eligible, scorable leader with the highest durability bar (0.73), full breadth (1.0), and the top rank/score — the narrative leadership is broad and intact, not a one-name squeeze. With absolute-trend gate validated as the staying-power leg and Gold Miners eligible, the discipline supports staying with the leadership while it holds trend; I am NOT concluding it will out-return, only that the trend/staying-power condition favours remaining exposed rather than rotating away.
theses.dissent: Cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is ~0 in the backtest, so ranking first carries no forward return edge; a mean-reverting or crowded precious-metals washout could hit the most-owned leader hardest.
